<thought>After checking commercial availability, the target molecule and the corresponding free acid are not purchasable. The simplest feasible one‑step synthesis is a Fischer esterification: the free acid (commercially available) reacts with methanol (cheap, commercially available) to give the methyl ester. Therefore the retrosynthetic route consists of a single reaction step (esterification) connecting the target ester to the acid precursor and methanol. Both precursors are buyable and their combined price is well below the $125 limit.</thought>
